name: Savitribai Phule
shortBio: Pioneering Indian anti-caste philosopher, feminist educator, and co-founder of the Satyashodhak Samaj who established India's first schools for girls and marginalized castes and theorized education as liberation from Brahmanical patriarchy.
centralQuestion: How do caste stratification and the denial of literacy jointly reproduce social subjugation, and why is universal education the primary emancipatory praxis?

keyWorks.title: Kavya Phule (Blossoms of Poetry)
keyWorks.description: Philosophical poems urging Shudras, Dalits, and women to break ideological slavery through rational inquiry and education.

keyWorks.title: Bavankashi Subodh Ratnakar
keyWorks.description: Poetic historiography of anti-caste truth-seeking praxis and egalitarian social reconstruction in nineteenth-century Maharashtra.
